body:
maria: Hi team — customer ACME (org: acme-inc) requested onboarding for zeta-3b (quant int8) to hosted. Priority: P2. Upload: s3://redwood/onboard/zeta-3b/v1. Eval summary: baseline parity on short/chat prompts but quality drop on longform. Asking for triage on quant quality + latency profiling. Target: ~150ms tail for small bursts.

jun: Can you paste the eval table and datasets?

maria: Quick paste: 
```
Eval dataset | ppl  | Rouge-L | latency (fp16) | latency (int8)
news        | 12.4 | 0.72    | 120ms          | 95ms
longform    | 18.9 | 0.60    | 210ms          | 160ms
chat        | 10.1 | 0.78    | 110ms          | 85ms
```
main issue is longform. We used openwebtext + internal summarization prompts. Full artifacts and eval harness: s3://redwood/onboard/zeta-3b/v1/eval.tar.gz. Tokenizer: hf/zeta-tokenizer-v1.

sophie: Quick checklist: license clearance done? quant reproducibility tests? container/image security scan? Who's owner for each?

eng-bot: checklist reminder: [license_check, container_scan, unit_tests, perf_bench]. See: /ops/checklists/model_bringup.

matt: I can run int8 quant experiments and per-token divergence (KL + token-diff). Need GPU pool (dedicated-g4dn x2) and a seed. ETA EOD if resources available.

ops-kate: For hosted rollout we need a safe policy. Proposal: canary 5% (24h) -> 25% (24h) -> 100% with automatic rollback if Rouge-L drops >2% on sentinel prompts or error rate >1.5%. Also need latency SLO at 95th pct.

jun: I'll assemble a 200-sample sentinel set focusing on longform and multi-turn contexts by noon. Include edge cases that previously triggered hallucinations.

sophie: Add gating: if hallucination rate >4% on sentinel set, block rollout. Also run KV-cache integrity and memory-leak tests (kv cache correctness on resumed sessions).

maria: Action items summary: 
- matt: run quant diffs + delta-LL + perf (int8 vs fp16)
- jun: longform sentinel set + evaluation harness
- sophie: license & security signoff + reproducibility checklist
- ops-kate: rollout config draft + rollback thresholds
Please update this thread with results. @matt ping when GPUs are ready :thumbsup:

matt: ack, scheduling now.

eng-bot: deploy request created: DR-2025 (for perf experiments).

maria: FYI customer expects ETA within 5 business days; flag ASAP if timeline slips.

sophie: Noted. If regressions persist, recommend dedicated capacity for that customer as fallback with pinned fp16 model.

matt: initial quant run finished — basic int8 (default qlinear) produces ~0.8 Rouge-L drop on longform sentinel. Running qlinear + bias correction and 2-pass calibration next. Logs below: 
```
$ python quantize.py --model s3://redwood/onboard/zeta-3b/v1 --method qlinear --calib_samples 1024 --out /tmp/zeta-int8
INFO: calibrating...
INFO: baseline rouge-L: 0.60 -> int8: 0.52
```
Posting per-sample diffs to s3 when available.

jun: good — once you post diffs I'll instrument the sentinel set to compute hallucination and rouge deltas per prompt.

maria: leaving thread open. tagging @ops-kate for rollout draft once metrics stabilize.

ops-kate: I'll sketch the rollout JSON and include automatic fallback to fp16 on rollback. Will post draft here.

matt: posted artifacts: s3://redwood/onboard/zeta-3b/v1/quant_runs/qlinear_v1/{metrics,logs}.zip. Next: try per-channel quant, 8-bit per-row, and 4-bit hybrid if needed.

sophie: reminder: ensure license file included and model card filled out (safety statements + allowed use cases).

maria: thanks all — we'll reconvene after matt's next run.
